headline: Rajputana Stainless Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Rajputana Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-Pursuant to the Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with…
detail: General Updates - Rajputana Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-Pursuant to the Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with Regulation 3 of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, the Company has received an information u/r. 10(5) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 of inter- se transfer of shares (by way of gift) amongst Promoter and Promoter Group.

sources.name: NSE filing - Rajputana Stainless Limited
sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
